name: block91-ssh-read-image-fix
provenance: user acceptance caught read_image workspace-path gap on ssh projects; fix verified by direct tool invocation with the user-uploaded image on the aliyun remote

scenario.before: resolveWorkspaceImagePath 仅支持本地 workspace_path（ssh 项目无本地路径 → workspace_unavailable，即用户验收报「读图通道定不住工作区路径」）
scenario.fix: ssh 分支走 workspaceGateway.resolveWorkspaceBackend：safeRemoteJoin 边界 + backend.stat 尺寸预检（4MB 上限）+ backend.read 远端读图 → vision provider 解读

assertion.visionDescription: 一个戴着潜水镜的DNA双螺旋结构。
